_: U-128/U-130 — how many options each page still draws with no usable title. The list is EMPTY and `bare` is 0: every page is at zero, so a page missing from this list must be at zero too. That makes the gate a ban rather than a budget from here on — a number may only SHRINK, and there is nothing left to shrink. test/test_option_tips.js fails the build when a page draws an option whose hover does not open with the option's own text. A <datalist> option is not counted: it is not in a <select>, it opens no popup of its own, and no browser shows a title on it.
